description:
Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other's ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It's the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you'll do more than join something — you'll add something.
The Vision Products Group (VPG) creates the technologies behind Apple Vision Pro and the spatial experiences that reach across Apple's platforms. Our team builds spatial media experiences such as Spatial Scenes, which turn a photo into an immersive 3D scene you can look around in. We work where machine learning meets computer graphics: we train models that generate 3D scenes from photos and videos, and we render them in real time on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Vision Pro. We are looking for an engineer with a strong machine learning background and a love of graphics who wants to take new ideas from prototype all the way to features used by millions of people.

Description
We are a team of computer graphics, multimedia, and machine learning experts, and we are looking for an engineer to help build the next generation of spatial media across Apple's platforms. You will design and train models that reconstruct and generate 3D scenes from photos and videos, and develop the rendering techniques that bring these scenes to life on Apple devices within the tight compute and memory budgets. You will work closely with software, hardware, algorithms, and UX teams to take your work from early prototypes to shipping features.

Responsibilities
Develops machine learning techniques that generate spatial media experiences, such as Spatial Scenes, from photos and videos.
Designs, trains, and evaluates models that predict 3D scene representations, such as 3D Gaussian splats, from a single image, a few views, or video.
Applies generative models, such as diffusion models, to create plausible content and improve the realism of generated scenes.
Develops rendering techniques for spatial media and works with graphics engineers to make them fast, stable, and visually robust on device.
Builds data and evaluation pipelines, including synthetic data, perceptual quality metrics, and structured visual review, for problems where ground-truth novel views are rarely available.
Partners with cross-functional teams to integrate new techniques into shipping features and see them through to release.

Minimum qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field and 3+ years of relevant industry or research experience.
Hands-on experience designing, training, and evaluating deep learning models for computer vision or graphics tasks.
Hands-on experience with 3D Gaussian splatting, such as per-scene optimization, feed-forward prediction, or custom rasterization.
Hands-on experience training or fine-tuning diffusion or other generative models for images, video, or 3D content.
Strong understanding of multi-view geometry and camera models, and of how 3D representations are rendered, including rasterization, alpha compositing, and volume rendering.
Proficiency in Python and PyTorch, JAX, or MLX.
Familiarity with C++, Objective-C, or Swift
Familiarity with Gen AI coding tools. Demonstrated ability to use them for design, code generation, and debugging.

Preferred qualifications
MS or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
Experience with novel view synthesis or 3D reconstruction from images or video, such as monocular depth estimation, NeRFs, multiplane images, or dynamic scene reconstruction.
Experience with real-time rendering or GPU programming (Metal, CUDA, or compute shaders), such as writing custom rendering kernels.
Experience optimizing models for on-device inference, such as quantization, distillation, and Core ML.
Experience with large-scale distributed training and building datasets, including rendering synthetic training data.
Familiarity with stereo and spatial media, including metric scale and viewing comfort, or with AR/VR rendering pipelines.
Track record of taking ideas from prototype to a shipped product or widely used project.
Clear communication and the ability to collaborate across ML, graphics, and product teams.
